baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated finding, restrictive exception, singular bayt, and plural muslimin make one household the exhaustive remainder.
baseline_models.mechanism: A survey operation excludes every alternative and counts a socially bounded household whose shared posture is relinquishment and handing-over.

activation_trace.role: Encountering a sought object supplies the survey act that establishes what remains.
Exclusion of every other instance closes the census around a single remainder.
The people of a house make the counted unit a relational household rather than masonry.
Relinquishing and handing over supply the household's shared posture of surrender.

changed_reading.before: Some Muslims happened to be present.
changed_reading.after: An exhaustive search resolves the surviving social field to exactly one surrendered household.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bayt can be an inhabited refuge, while muslimin can carry freedom from harm and defect.
baseline_models.mechanism: Existence, exception, shelter, and safety overlap so that the sole household is also the sole locus qualifying as sound refuge.

activation_trace.role: Established existence makes the clause test whether any qualifying refuge is present.
Restrictive exclusion leaves no second locus of the same kind.
Dwelling and shelter provide the spatial container in which safety can be located.
Freedom from injury or defect supplies the criterion by which the refuge is distinguished.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely gives a religious headcount.
changed_reading.after: The headcount is spatialized as one inhabited pocket of soundness and safety.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular household and the peace branch of s-l-m permit a miniature social-order reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bayt gathers persons into one corporate unit, while peace rather than conflict names the relation that holds it together.

activation_trace.role: The exception isolates one corporate unit from every unlike unit.
Household membership supplies the small-scale social body.
Peace in opposition to war supplies the relation organizing that social body.

changed_reading.after: The label can characterize the smallest peace-bearing polity: one household.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entry, reciprocal peace speech, and continued nonrecognition make the house a boundary that receives difference without immediately converting it into hostility.

activation_trace.role: The dwelling supplies the bounded threshold across which the encounter is managed.
Peace opposed to war supplies the household's governing response to outsiders.
Movement into an interior turns the dwelling boundary into an active part of the encounter.
Reciprocal peacemaking demonstrates the nonhostile relation enacted at that boundary.
Lack of recognition preserves real otherness, preventing peace from being reduced to familiarity.

structural_cues: 51:25 orders entry, reciprocal salam, and nonrecognition without resolving the strangers into kin.
51:36 makes one bayt, not an unbounded collection of persons, the surviving unit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry, exchanged peace, and continuing nonrecognition; I assign the house the role of holding those conditions together. A live alternative is ordinary guest etiquette with no definition of the later Muslim household.

changed_reading.before: The one house contains people already classed as Muslims.
changed_reading.after: The one Muslim house is a threshold polity able to hold unknown entry within peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Movement toward the household, procurement of food, bringing it near, and inviting consumption enact bayt as a coordinated domestic economy rather than a static address.

activation_trace.role: The people and dependents of a house supply the coordinated domestic agent.
Near belonging and household affiliation identify the source of domestic provision.
Bringing the offering near converts stored provision into an available relation with guests.
Eating supplies the intended act of incorporation and shared sustenance.

structural_cues: 51:26-27 moves from ahl to a prepared calf, proximity, and an invitation to eat.
The later singular bayt can therefore name an operating household rather than only its enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household affiliation and an offered meal; I infer that coordinated provisioning is evidence for what bayt counts socially. The alternative is that the meal characterizes only the host and does not revise 51:36.

changed_reading.before: Bayt is the building in which the saved group resides.
changed_reading.after: Bayt is a household enacted through coordinated belonging, provision, and offered incorporation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promised youth appears against age and barrenness, while a non-dominant growth branch under r-b-b keeps one household from reading only as terminal scarcity: singularity can be a minimum viable beginning.

activation_trace.role: The household supplies the unit capable of carrying continuity across generations.
Joy-opening news supplies the announced reversal of an apparently closed future.
Youth supplies the concrete carrier of renewed household continuity.
Advanced age supplies the temporal closure that the announcement overturns.
Blocked generation supplies the biological impossibility against which one can become seed rather than residue.
Nurture into growth supplies the directional reversal from terminal scarcity to continuity.

structural_cues: 51:28-30 places announced youth after fear and directly against old age and barrenness.
51:36 emphatically leaves one household, a count that can signal either exhaustion or seed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a barren household receiving a future and later a sole household; I infer a cross-household analogy in which one is generative potential. The live alternative is simple narrative juxtaposition with no transfer to the focus count.

changed_reading.before: One household is a depleted final residue.
changed_reading.after: One household may be the minimum generative seed through which continuity remains possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A culpable collective is assigned hard mixed-material projectiles bearing visible marks for limit-crossers; the focus exception then reads as the result of discriminating household-level sorting rather than indiscriminate devastation.

activation_trace.role: Finding supplies the post-selection audit that verifies what the targeting spared.
Exception isolates the sole household falling outside the targeted class.
Household membership supplies the social granularity at which the exception is recorded.
Soundness and freedom from injury supply the spared class's contrast with the struck collective.
Culpability and offense define the collective selected for punishment.
Hard stone supplies the bounded destructive payload.
Mixed clay supplies the payload's prepared material specificity.
A visible identifying mark supplies discriminability rather than random impact.
Crossing a limit supplies the criterion attaching the marked payload to its recipients.

structural_cues: 51:32 names the recipient collective, 51:33-34 specifies and marks the payload, and 51:35 extracts before 51:36 reports one exception.
The singular bayt is grammatically inside an exhaustive negative-exception construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a named culpable group, marked projectiles, and a sole household exception; I infer that the exception evidences fine-grained targeting. The alternative is a simple survivor count unrelated to how the punishment was assigned.

changed_reading.before: One household happens to survive a collective disaster.
changed_reading.after: The one-house result audits a judgment able to distinguish a sound household within a culpable collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding extraction ranges over whoever was present among the believers, but the focus finding counts one household among those who surrender; trust is gathered personwise and surrender is registered housewise.

activation_trace.role: Finding supplies the second classificatory operation after extraction.
Household membership changes the unit of classification from persons to a corporate domestic body.
Relinquishment supplies the coordinated outward posture predicated of that household.
Passage to the outside supplies the rescue operation applied to persons.
Being present at a time supplies the membership test over whoever was then inside.
Settled affirmation supplies the person-level quality named before the household-level reclassification.

structural_cues: 51:35 uses an unrestricted person expression with plural believers; 51:36 uses singular bayt with plural muslimin.
The locative fiha repeats across both clauses while the classifier and counted unit change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent changes in noun, number, and classification; I infer a deliberate shift in granularity from inwardly trusting persons to a collectively surrendered house. The live alternative is synonymous restatement with ordinary singular-house/plural-inhabitants agreement.

changed_reading.before: Believers and Muslims are two interchangeable labels in a repeated rescue statement.
changed_reading.after: The rescue gathers believers personwise, while the audit recognizes submission embodied housewise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extraction removes the only safe dwelling, and the following verse leaves a visible warning in the same place; the focus count becomes the hinge by which inhabited presence is converted into legible absence.

activation_trace.role: Established existence supplies the presence whose removal can leave negative-space evidence.
The sole exception makes the later vacancy maximally legible.
The inhabited refuge supplies the concrete presence removed from the place.
Safety distinguishes the evacuated presence from the punished surroundings.
Movement out of an interior supplies the transition from inhabited refuge to vacancy.
Leaving an effect behind supplies persistence after the household is gone.
A manifest sign turns the altered place into readable evidence.
Anticipation of harm supplies the future audience's mode of reading the trace.
Punitive pain supplies what the retained trace warns that audience about.

structural_cues: Fiha recurs in 51:35, 51:36, and 51:37 while the verbs move through extraction, finding, and leaving.
The sequence changes the same place from container of people, to site of a sole-house audit, to carrier of a sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evacuation, a sole dwelling, and a sign left in the same place; I infer that the dwelling's absence participates in the sign. The live alternative is that only material ruins, not the vacated household, constitute the sign.

changed_reading.before: The one-house count closes the rescue report.
changed_reading.after: The count mediates a presence-to-trace reversal: removing the only safe house makes its absence part of the warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage moves from report, through disclosed knowledge and marked recipients, to finding and visible sign; the focus clause functions as an evidentiary observation inside that chain.

activation_trace.role: Discovery supplies the verification event between narrated mission and enduring evidence.
Exhaustive exception gives the verification a precise negative result.
A report renewed as news supplies the passage's initial mode of transmitted evidence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic authority behind the announced action.
An identifying mark supplies inspectable correspondence between payload and recipient.
A visible sign converts the completed event into evidence for later observers.

structural_cues: The unit begins as a reported account, repeatedly stages speech and disclosed mission, and ends with a sign.
The first-person plural finding in 51:36 sits immediately before that sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, knowledge, marking, discovery, and sign; I infer an evidentiary chain in which the focus count is a warranted observation. The alternative is that these are narrative links without a distinct forensic function.

changed_reading.before: The one-house clause is incidental narrative detail.
changed_reading.after: The one-house clause is the passage's precise verification result, later externalized as a sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant j-d-d target beneath the focus verb instead of its ordinary finding sense. It remains anchored by that supplied split branch, the focus exception, and contextual cutting and extraction; downstream prose should call it a form-distant severed-remnant resonance, never a translation or morphological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory under the focus verb offers cutting, while the exception and singular household provide the intact unit cut away from the collective.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and severance supply the outlier image of an intact unit excised from its surroundings.
Exception supplies the boundary around the severed remainder.
The household supplies the social unit imagined as removed intact.
Cutting off supplies a context echo for separation of the culpable collective.
Passage outward supplies the actual directional removal that makes excision coherent.

changed_reading.before: The verse discovers a leftover household.
changed_reading.after: At a deliberately form-distant level, the verse can picture one household severed intact from a collective being cut off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the solid-stone branch under s-l-m in direct resonance with the destructive stones. The packet supplies both branches and the house anchor, so the material analogy is inspectable; downstream prose must present it only as an exploratory cohesion image, not as the meaning of muslimin or as a claim that hardness equals virtue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The singular bayt is modified by a form from s-l-m, whose inventory includes stone solidity, while the immediate context sends marked stones.

activation_trace.role: The dwelling supplies the bounded structure whose cohesion is placed under pressure.
Stone free of softness supplies an unlikely material image of structural and social cohesion.
Hard projectiles supply the destructive material against which the cohesion image reverses.
Visible marking keeps the stone pressure discriminating rather than indiscriminate.
Limit-crossing identifies the social field against which the one coherent house is contrasted.

changed_reading.before: Stone belongs only to the machinery of destruction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, stone also figures the cohesion of the sole house distinguished within that destruction.

strongest_changes: The negative-exception count becomes an audit of discriminating judgment, not an accidental survivor statistic.
The transition from plural believers in 51:35 to one household of muslimin in 51:36 shifts classification from persons to a corporate domestic embodiment.
The repeated fiha sequence converts the only safe household's presence into an absence that participates in the visible warning of 51:37.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots jointly made bayt a social unit and s-l-m a field of surrender, safety, and peace; split-root and material branches also preserved the generative-seed, severed-remnant, and stone-cohesion readings that a conservative synthesis would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The person-to-house scale shift may be deliberate semantic differentiation or ordinary synonymous restatement.
The generative analogy across households and the material solidity resonance are packet-anchored but remain branch-distant.
The sign in 51:37 may be constituted by material ruins alone rather than by the evacuated household's negative space.
